tools.name: search_gpu_offers
tools.description: Find single cloud GPUs (on demand) you can rent right now, cheapest first, across all tracked clouds. Returns price per GPU-hour in USD, cloud, stock level, regions and a link to rent.

tools.name: list_gpus
tools.description: All tracked GPU models with VRAM, the cheapest price you can rent each at right now (data center and community) and how many clouds have it in stock.

tools.name: get_gpu
tools.description: Specs and every offer (all clouds, in stock or not) for one GPU model.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Every GPU cloud in the index, with its website, whether it is a marketplace or reseller, and how many offers it has in stock.
